steps.what: Open medical records, specimens, and medications
Deliver medical records, specimens, and medications
Take the signature at hospitals and other medical facilities

tasks.design: The run list of medical records, lab specimens, and medications is opened from {OPS_SYSTEM}. The courier delivers them to hospitals and other medical facilities and takes a signature. The items stay sealed. {DOCS} stores the item id and the signature, not the contents. A missing item id is not marked delivered.
tasks.previous_blocker: The custody note was a paper slip copied from the run sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: The item id is already on the run.
tasks.still_hard: Carrying sealed items and seeing who signed stay with the courier.
tasks.human_edge: The courier holds the item and sees the person.

ambition.what: A listed item can be handed over on the stop, and the courier still takes the signature.

tasks.altitude: The courier takes the signature before the item is marked delivered.

reach.learn: Which item id was signed for.

evidence.claim: An item id can be stored with a signature. Carrying sealed medical items and taking the signature stay with the courier. A stored stop list can show the item id, the address, and the order of stops already entered. The courier still travels, loads, and hands over. A handover or a payment stops when the item id does not match.

The source pack says a digital consignment note is not accepted on every road, and that tools logging who did what need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score the courier. Health-related items stay sealed: the log stores the item id and the signature, not the contents. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a medical run is assigned and ends when each item is signed for or brought back.
A run row has item id, kind, and facility, entered by the dispatcher. The kind is a label such as record, specimen, or medication. The contents are not fields.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the courier's effort.
A missing address, item id, or amount is not invented. The courier does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened stop when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the facility will not sign.
research_questions: Which items were signed for, and which came back?

already_counted.description: The trip or the note is already in the courier's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened stop when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: The item id and the signature taken at the facility

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the facility will not sign and the courier brings the item back. High: the item id is on the run and the courier still carries it and takes the signature. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show destinations for messages and materials
Ride bicycles, drive vehicles, or use public conveyances to reach destinations
Deliver the messages or materials on arrival

tasks.design: Destinations for messages and materials are shown from {OPS_SYSTEM}. The courier walks, rides bicycles, drives vehicles, or uses public conveyances to reach them, then delivers. The screen does not move the courier.
tasks.previous_blocker: The destination was a note in a pocket.
tasks.enabler_now: The destination is on the stop.
tasks.still_hard: The travelling stays with the courier.
tasks.human_edge: The courier chooses how to get there.
tasks.altitude: The trip does not change. The destination is only easier to read.

The source pack says a digital consignment note is not accepted on every road, and that tools logging who did what need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score the courier. Health-related items stay sealed: the log stores the item id and the signature, not the contents. Other countries differ.

A stop row has stop id and address, entered by the dispatcher.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the courier's effort.

steps.what: Open listed goods for the vehicles
Load the goods, ensuring they are loaded correctly
Keep taking precautions with hazardous goods

tasks.design: The list of goods for the vehicle is opened from {OPS_SYSTEM}. The courier loads them, ensuring they are loaded correctly, and keeps taking precautions with hazardous goods. The list does not lift the goods. A hazard label that is not on the list is not ignored.
tasks.previous_blocker: The load list was a handwritten sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: The goods and their labels are already on the run.
tasks.still_hard: Lifting, stowing, and the hazard precautions stay with the courier.
tasks.human_edge: The courier sees the label and the vehicle.
tasks.altitude: The loading does not change. The list only names what should be on board.

evidence.claim: A stored load list can name the goods. Loading and hazard precautions stay with the courier. A stored stop list can show the item id, the address, and the order of stops already entered. The courier still travels, loads, and hands over. A handover or a payment stops when the item id does not match.

The source pack says a digital consignment note is not accepted on every road, and that tools logging who did what need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score the courier. Health-related items stay sealed: the log stores the item id and the signature, not the contents. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a vehicle is being loaded and ends when the goods are stowed or a hazard is set aside.
A load row has item id and a hazard flag entered by the dispatcher. The flag is a label, not a judgement of the contents.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the courier's effort.
A missing address, item id, or amount is not invented. The courier does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened stop when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the label on the goods does not match the list.
research_questions: Which loads matched the list, and which hazardous goods were set aside?

already_counted.description: The trip or the note is already in the courier's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened stop when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: labels do not match the list. High: the list matches and the courier still loads and takes precautions. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open names, addresses, and telephone numbers
Receive messages communicated by telephone, radio, or in person
Record delivery instructions and information on recipients for materials delivered

tasks.design: Names, addresses, and telephone numbers already on a stop are opened from {OPS_SYSTEM}. The courier still receives messages or materials by telephone, two-way radio, or in person, and records the delivery instructions and the recipient information. A field the caller did not give stays blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: The courier wrote the address on a scrap during the call.
tasks.enabler_now: Known stops already have name, address, and number.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing a new instruction, and writing what was actually said, stay with the courier.

ambition.what: A known stop opens during the call, and the courier still writes any new instruction.

tasks.altitude: The courier hears the instruction before it is stored.

evidence.claim: Known name, address, and telephone fields can be opened. Hearing and writing a new instruction stay with the courier. A stored stop list can show the item id, the address, and the order of stops already entered. The courier still travels, loads, and hands over. A handover or a payment stops when the item id does not match.

The source pack says a digital consignment note is not accepted on every road, and that tools logging who did what need consent where a works council has that right. This work does not score the courier. Health-related items stay sealed: the log stores the item id and the signature, not the contents. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a message or a material is handed to the courier and ends when the stop row is saved or the courier has asked for a missing field.
A stop row has name, address, telephone, and instruction. The courier types the instruction. An empty address is not filled from a guess.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the courier's effort.
A missing address, item id, or amount is not invented. The courier does that part.
The incremental hour updates the opened stop when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the instruction arrives only by radio, with no existing stop.
research_questions: Which stops were already on file, and which the courier created from the call?

incremental.description: Update the opened stop when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the call has no existing stop, so the courier writes every field. High: name, address, and number are stored and the courier only adds the instruction. The range stays under the net.

skills_to_grow: Do not open a sealed medical item.
